summary: Iteration 4: WhatsApp click-to-chat ordering tested end to end. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (enable-without-number 400, number regex 422 for letters/+/short/long, message >300 422, enable+save keeps delivery rates/rounding/deadline, public /api/catalog exposes whatsapp fields, country-code number accepted, restore). Frontend: admin Settings form (error toast when enabling without a number, digits-only number input, save persists after reload), float button href https://wa.me/919876543210?text=<encoded opening msg> at bottom-left with no overlap with Ask Laado, cart WhatsApp href includes item names, weights, qty, Items, Delivery (India/Abroad, weight), Total matching cart-total, Name:/Delivery address:, and the href changes when destination is toggled (India total 750 -> Abroad total 1,200). Disabling hides both buttons. At 390px the float button is icon-only (52px wide), doesn't overlap Laado, and the cart WhatsApp button fits in the viewport. Settings restored to the requested defaults and checked via /api/catalog.

ui_bugs.issue: Tab testid is admin-tab-settings, but the visible label still says 'Delivery' (AdminDashboard.jsx line 20). Review request says it was renamed to Settings.

issues: Icon-only WhatsApp float button has no aria-label/title (accessibility). Add aria-label='Order on WhatsApp'.

action_items: Rename the admin tab label from 'Delivery' to 'Settings' in AdminDashboard.jsx: ["settings", "Settings", SettingsPanel]
Add aria-label='Order on WhatsApp' to whatsapp-float-button
critical_code_review_comments: Optional: the cart WhatsApp message leaves out the order type (Diwali/Regular) that checkout collects. The owner may want it in the message.
Optional: if the quote request fails (quote=null), the WhatsApp message is sent without totals. That is acceptable but silent.
seed_data_creation: None. Settings restored to india 250, abroad 450, round_up, 2026-11-05, whatsapp disabled, empty number, default message.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp ordering is verified. test_whatsapp_settings.py restores settings in the fixture teardown. Public settings come from /api/catalog.settings. Razorpay returns 503 by design.
